card.name: Goal and target statements before the target
card.fires_on: Small words just before the target or aim in a goal statement, such as 'to' after 'reduce ... births' or 'aims to', and the 'than' in 'no more than'. Also words before a number or standard that a goal sets.

modes.label: Goal wording before a number
modes.description: A linking word or space right before a target figure or percentage in a stated goal.
modes.example: March of Dimes 2020 Goal Reduce preterm births<< to>> no more than 9.6%

modes.label: Aim or standard phrases
modes.description: Words inside statements of what a program aims to achieve or meet.
modes.example: The Human Brain Project aims<< to>> lay the technical foundations for a new model

card.plain: It fires on little words in goal statements, just before the target is named.
